Icons in this kit
=================

PLACEHOLDER — not final art.

The glyphs rendered by `<span class="icon">name</span>` come from Material
Icons (Google, Apache License 2.0). They are stand-ins so that every
component can be shown with the icon it would really carry. They are not
part of the Wavefront design language and are expected to be replaced by a
purpose-drawn set before this kit ships anywhere real.

Where it lives
--------------
assets/fonts/MaterialIcons.woff2   (128 KB, ligature-based icon font)

Declared once in design_language.css as the `Material Icons` @font-face,
consumed by the `.icon` class. Nothing else in the kit knows about it.

Hard rule: no externally hosted assets
--------------------------------------
Nothing in this kit may reference a third-party host — no CDN fonts, no
remote stylesheets, no remote scripts, no remote images. Everything is
either shipped in assets/, inlined as a data: URI, or drawn in CSS. The
icon font was downloaded for exactly this reason; the previous
fonts.googleapis.com <link> has been removed from every page.

If you add an icon, use the ligature name only (e.g. `check`, `menu`,
`expand_more`). Do not hard-code a codepoint — a codepoint would have to be
re-mapped when the real set lands, a ligature name would not.

Replacing the set later
-----------------------
1. Drop the new font in assets/fonts/.
2. Point the one @font-face in design_language.css at it.
3. Reconcile the ligature names used across the pages:
   grep -oh 'class="icon[^"]*">[a-z_]*' *.html | sort -u
